public.how.title: Frɔm plantin det go na stej
public.how.lead: Dɛn de put di stej bay an, so i de kɔrɛkt ɔnli go te di las apdet. Ya, dɛn de tek am frɔm wɛda we dɛn rikɔd, ɛn ɛni chenj de kip di pruf.
public.step.1.title: Rikɔd wetin di fama no
public.step.1.body: Dɛn de kip fam dɛn, fil dɛn, krop dɛn ɛn plantin det dɛn na Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Tek di wɛda we dɔn apin
public.step.2.body: Di ɛvride tɛmprɛcha fɔ di fil kɔdinets de kam frɔm di Open-Meteo ol rikɔd, frɔm plantin go te tide.
public.step.3.title: Ad di degree days
public.step.3.body: Dɛn de ad growing degree days (GDD) akɔdin to di krop mɔdɛl. Wen i pas di mak, di sistɛm de muv di sizɔn go na di nɛks stej ɛn rikɔd wetin mek am du so.
public.models.title: Krop mɔdɛl dɛn we wi de yuz
public.models.lead: Di degree days we i nid fɔ rich fɔ avɛst bay it. Dɛn rayt dis sɛtin dɛn bay an, ɛn nɔ sɔs nɔ de yet.
public.live.title: Wetin de apin na di Swartland tɛst fam
public.live.lead: Ridin dɛn frɔm pɔblik sɔs dɛn, we de apdet ɛvri 30 minit.
public.yields.title: Avɛst amɔnt mak dɛn we dɛn dɔn pablish
public.honesty.title: Aw dɛn de yuz di data
public.honesty.1.title: Di ɔpareta de put di avɛst amɔnt
public.honesty.1.body: Te di wokman rayt di amɔnt we i avɛst, di app go sho “Nɔ rayt am yet”.
public.honesty.2.title: Mak fɔ kɔmpia na difrɛn rikɔd
public.honesty.2.body: Di rijɔn ɛn kɔntri statistiks dɛn de na dɛn yon dɔkyumɛnt wit di sɔs ɛn unit. Dɛn nɔ de kɔmpia dɛn wit wetin wan fil avɛst.
public.honesty.3.title: Pɛst rikɔd dɛn na fɔ di rijɔn
public.honesty.3.body: GBIF de sho usay dɛn si pɛst insay 100 km, wit aw fa i de.
public.honesty.4.title: Wɛda de kam layv
public.honesty.4.body: Wen yu aks, dɛn de pul di tɛmprɛcha dɛn frɔm di Open-Meteo akayv.
public.open.title: Opin wan sizɔn
public.open.body: Sayn in na di dɛmo dashbɔd fɔ si di sizɔn GDD layn ɛn di pruf fɔ in stej.

public.yield.lead: Di tri layn dɛn de mɛzhɔ difrɛn tin na difrɛn skel. Yu nɔ fɔ kɔmpia dɛn wit dɛnsɛf ɔ wit ɛni fil.
public.about.title: Bɔt am
public.about.heading: Bɔt Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis na fil ɛn krɔp traka fɔ wan fam na Wɛstɛn Kep.
public.about.why.title: Wetɛn mek i de
public.about.why.body: Di stej infɔmeshɔn de ol, ɛn pipul de rayt avɛst frɔm mɛmri. Mecropolis de kalkyulet di stej frɔm wɛda we dɛn rikɔd. Ɛvri nɔmba de kam frɔm wan wokman ɔ wan pɔblik sɔs we gɛt nem.
public.about.design.title: Aw dɛn bil am
public.about.design.1.body: Growing degree days de ad frɔm di de we dɛn plant, yuz di Open-Meteo akayv. Ɛvri chenj na stej de kip in pruf: di de we i bigin, di GDD total, ɛn wetin dɛn yuz fɔ kalkyulet am.
public.about.design.2.body: Di stej afta bifo avɛst gɛt di nem dɔn machɔ bikɔs ɔf it, bikɔs nɔ avɛst ivɛnt nɔ de na rikɔd.
public.about.design.3.lead: Na di wokman de rayt di avɛst.
public.about.design.4.lead: Mak dɛn na fɔ gi kɔntɛks.
public.about.design.4.body: Dɛn de kip dɛn na dɛn yon dɔkyumɛnt wit sɔs, unit ɛn laysɛns.
public.about.stack.title: Tɛknɔlɔji dɛn
public.about.stack.body: Na wan Vite ɛn React 19 singul-pej app na Cloudflare Pages. Di browza de rid di pɔblik Sanity data dayrɛkt wit GROQ ɛn wan layv lisina. Raytin ɛn data we nid ki de pas tru Cloudflare Pages Functions, we de chɛk wan sayn sɛshɔn kuki. Zod de chɛk data we de go in ɛn kɔmɔt, Vitest na fɔ tɛst, ɛn Tailwind 4 na fɔ stayl.
public.about.limits.title: Limit dɛn we wi no
public.about.limits.1: Dɛn rayt di krɔp mɔdɛl sɛtin dɛn (bes tɛmprɛcha, it we di krɔp nid fɔ kamɔt, ɛn it fɔ machɔ) bay an, ɛn dɛn nɔ gɛt sɔs yet.
public.about.limits.2: Di lupin mak kɔmɔt na HarvestStat fɔ 2000 to 2007 nɔmɔ, ɛn di fɔs data rɔn nɔ fɛn ɛni lupin mak dɔkyumɛnt.
public.about.limits.3: Di pɛst data na GBIF rikɔd dɛn nia di fam. Dɛn de sho usay dɛn rikɔd wan spishis nia di fam.
public.about.limits.4: Di dɛmo gɛt wan sayn-in we ɔlman de yuz, ɛn wan limit we de kip na mɛmri. Di sayn-in de ayd di dashbɔd pej dɛn, bɔt i nɔ de protɛkt di data: ɛnibɔdi kin rid di dataset. Bɔt i de protɛkt ɛvri raytin.

docs.stages.title: Stej mashin
docs.stages.intro: Sizɔn dɛn de go fɔdɔm tru siks stej:
docs.stages.guards: Ɛvri muv gɛt chɛk. Plant nid plantin det ɛn krɔp; groin nid di degree days mak fɔ di krɔp kamɔt; bifo avɛst nid 90% ɔf di mak fɔ machɔ; it we di krɔp dɔn machɔ nid fɔ rich di machɔ mak; rivyu nid wan sizɔn wɛda snapshɔt ɛn wan mak we dɛn dɔn fɛn. GDD chɛk dɛn sef nid tɛmprɛcha data fɔ lɛk 90% ɔf di tɛm, ɛn dɛn de blɔk ɛni muv we in stat det de na di fyucha.

docs.seed.body: {0} de rayt di dɛmɔ fam, fil dɛn, krɔp dɛn ɛn sizɔn dɛn insay di data ples we yu sɛt, ɛn i de mek di eria mak dɛn mach. I de chenj di fam, fil dɛn ɛn krɔp dɛn, so rɔn am nɔmɔ pan data we na yu yon.
guide.title: Aw fɔ yus Mecropolis
guide.lead: Dis na shɔt gayd wit izi wɔd dɛn. I de tɛl yu wetin di app fɔ, udat fɔ yus am, ɛn wetin ɛni pat de du.
guide.what.title: Wetin Mecropolis bi
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis de kip trak pan fam fil dɛn ɛn krɔp dɛn. I de ad di wom weda frɔm we dɛn plant di krɔp fɔ no usay i rich, ɛn i de sho yu di weda, grɔn ɛn pest dɛn nia yu fam na wan ples.
guide.what.p2: Dɛn bil am fɔ fam dɛn na Wɛstɛn Kep na Sawt Afrika, bɔt di sem tin de wok fɔ ɛni fam, ɛni eria ɛn ɛni sizɔn.
guide.who.title: Udat fɔ yus am
guide.who.p1: Na fɔ di pɔsin we de luk afta di fil dɛn, lɛk fama, fam manejɔ ɔ advaysa we de ɛp dɛn.
guide.who.p2: Yu nɔ nid fɔ sabi kɔmpyuta ɔ weda sayɛns. If yu ebul opin wɛbsayt, yu ebul yus Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Wetɛn mek yu go yus am
guide.why.1: Yu go si wantɛm us krɔp dɛn dɛn jɔs plant, us wan dɛn de gro, ɛn us wan dɛn dɔn nia fɔ rɛdi.
guide.why.2: Yu nɔ nid fɔ apdet ɛni fil wit an, bikɔs di app de muv ɛni krɔp go bifo ɔn in yon we di weda sho se na in tɛm.
guide.why.3: I de wɔn yu bɔt frɔst ɛn bɔku it fɔ di nɛks fyu dez, ɛn bɔt pest dɛn we dɛn si nia yu fam.
guide.why.4: Ɛnitin we dɛn rayt bɔt wan fil, lɛk spre, pest we yu si ɔ not, de na wan ples wit in det, so yu go ebul luk bak leta.
guide.why.5: Ɛni nɔmba de sho usay i kɔmɔt, so yu go no wetin yu ebul biliv.
guide.heat.title: Aw di app de no usay di krɔp rich
guide.heat.p1: Plant dɛn de gro kwik we ples wom, ɛn slo we ples kol. Mecropolis de kɔnt dis wom ɛvri de as it yunit dɛn, we sayɛntis dɛn de kɔl growing degree days ɔ GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Ɛvri de, i de tek di midul bitwin di ayɛst ɛn loɛst tɛmprɛchɔ, ɛn pul di tɛmprɛchɔ we di krɔp de tap fɔ gro. Wetin lɛf na di it yunit dɛn fɔ dat de. Kol de nɔ de ad natin.
guide.heat.p3: Ɛni krɔp nid wan patikyula it yunit total bifo i rɛdi. As di total frɔm we dɛn plant am de nia dat nɔmba, di krɔp de muv go na di nɛks stej.
guide.heat.p4: Di tɛmprɛchɔ dɛn de kɔmɔt na Open-Meteo, wan fri weda savis we de rikɔd weda fɔ ɛni ples na di wɔl.
guide.stages.title: Di siks stej dɛn
guide.stages.intro: Ɛni krɔp na ɛni fil de pas tru dis stej dɛn na dis ɔda.
guide.stages.planning: Dɛn dɔn sɛt di sizɔn, bɔt di krɔp nɔ de na grɔn yet.
guide.stages.growing: Di krɔp de gɛda it yunit dɛn.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Di krɔp dɔn gɛda mɔs pan di it we i nid, so na tɛm fɔ rɛdi fɔ avɛst.
guide.stages.harvested: Di krɔp dɔn gɛda ɔl di it we i nid, so i fɔ dɔn rɛdi. Na yu nɔmɔ ebul se if dɛn rili avɛst am, so di app de kɔl dis rɛdi bikɔs ɔf it.
guide.stages.review: Di sizɔn dɔn dɔn, ɛn yu ebul luk bak aw i go.
guide.stages.p2: Di app de chɛk ɛni krɔp ɛvri nɛt ɛn ɛni tɛm pɔsin ad wetin i si ɔ wok we dɛn du. Yu ebul prez Reconcile now pan wan sizɔn fɔ chɛk wantɛm.
guide.start.title: Aw fɔ stat
guide.start.1: Opin di om pej. Yu ebul si di weda map, grɔn, pest dɛn ɛn yild dɛn fɔ di dɛmɔ fam witawt fɔ sayn in.
guide.start.2: Prez Sign in ɔp, ɛn yus di dɛmɔ akawnt ditel dɛn we dɛn gi yu.
guide.start.3: Pik wan fam. Dis go opin di dashbɔd fɔ dat fam.
guide.start.4: Prez wan sizɔn fɔ si ɔltin bɔt dat wan krɔp pan dat wan fil.
guide.start.5: Yus di langwej bɔks ɔp pan ɛni pej fɔ chenj di langwej. Di app go mɛmba wetin yu pik di nɛks tɛm.
guide.home.title: Di om pej
guide.home.p1: Di om pej de sho map fɔ di eria, wit kɔlɔ dɛn we de sho aw bɔku it di land dɔn gɛt dis sizɔn. I de sho di weda naw ɛn fɔ di nɛks fyu dez, di grɔn na di dɛmɔ fam, pest dɛn we dɛn si nia de dis las tɛm, ɛn di avɛrij yild dɛn fɔ di eria. Yu nɔ nid fɔ sayn in fɔ si am.
guide.dashboard.title: Di fam dashbɔd
guide.dashboard.intro: Di dashbɔd de sho wan fam. Dis na in pat dɛn frɔm ɔp to dɔn pan di pej. Di fam bɔks ɔp de lɛ yu jɔmp go na ɔda fam.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Fam sɔmari
guide.dashboard.summary: Aw bɔku fil ɛn ha di fam gɛt, aw bɔku sizɔn de rɔn, ɛn aw bɔku krɔp dɔn rɛdi.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Nid atɛnshɔn
guide.dashboard.alerts: Shɔt wɔnin dɛn, lɛk frɔst ɔ bɔku it na di fɔkast, krɔp we dɔn rɛdi, sizɔn we nɔ stat na in tɛm, ɔ pest dɛn we dɛn si nia wan fil. Ɛni wɔnin de se wetin kɔz am.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Aw tin dɛn de na di fam
guide.dashboard.conditions: Tide weda, di fɔkast, di grɔn ɛn pest dɛn nia dis fam.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Aw di sizɔn de go
guide.dashboard.progress: Wan kad fɔ ɛni krɔp we de sho aw bɔku it i dɔn gɛda. Yu ebul kɔmpia fil dɛn say bay say, ɛn dawnlod di lis as sprɛdshit fayl (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Fil dɛn
guide.dashboard.fields: Ɛni fil na di fam wit in sayz, in grɔn ɛn in krɔp dɛn.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Luk fɔ rikɔd dɛn
guide.dashboard.search: Tayp wetin yu de luk fɔ wit nɔmal wɔd dɛn, lɛk afid dɛn pan wit. I de fɛn wetin dɛn si ɛn wok we dɛn du we min di sem tin, ivin if dɛn yus ɔda wɔd dɛn.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Wok we dɛn advays
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Wok we dɛn advays fɔ wan fil, lɛk spre ɔ fɔtilayza. Yu ebul apruv ɔ rijɛkt ɛni wan, ɛn mak am dɔn we di wok finish.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Wetin apin dis las tɛm
guide.dashboard.activity: Lis we de sho di tɛm ɛni krɔp muv go na nyu stej.
guide.season.title: Di sizɔn pej
guide.season.intro: Wan sizɔn na wan krɔp pan wan fil insay wan ia. In pej gɛt ɔltin bɔt am.
guide.season.top.label: Di pej in ɔp
guide.season.top: Di krɔp, di fil, di plantin det, di det we dɛn ɛkspɛkt fɔ avɛst, ɛn di yild afta yu put am.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Di stej dɛn
guide.season.pipeline: Di siks stej dɛn, wit di wan we i de naw mak. Prez Reconcile now fɔ chɛk wantɛm if di krɔp fɔ muv go.
guide.season.readiness.label: If i rɛdi fɔ disayd
guide.season.readiness: Lis fɔ chɛk wetin di app nid bifo i ebul muv di krɔp go, lɛk plantin det ɛn inɔf weda data. Ɛni wan de se Pass, Warning ɔ Blocked, ɛn di wan we blɔk de tɛl yu wetin nɔ de.
guide.season.evidence.label: Pruf
guide.season.evidence: Di rikɔd dɛn we di app yus fɔ mek in disizhɔn dɛn, so yu ebul chɛk dɛn.
guide.season.propose.label: Advays wan wok
guide.season.propose: Advays wok fɔ dis fil, wit di sizɔn pruf atach. I go wet as draft te pɔsin apruv am pan di dashbɔd.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Chat we de sho di it yunit dɛn we de ad ɔp frɔm plantin, wit layn fɔ di total we di krɔp nid.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Wetin if?
guide.season.whatIf: Tray plant ɛli ɔ let, ɔ tray sizɔn we wom mɔ ɔ kol mɔ, ɛn si aw di it yunit dɛn go chenj. Natin nɔ go sev.
guide.season.summary.label: Sizɔn sɔmari
guide.season.summary: Shɔt sɔmari fɔ di sizɔn rikɔd dɛn we AI rayt. Yus am as ɛp, ɛn chɛk di rikɔd dɛn if sɔntin luk rɔng.
guide.season.notes.label: Sizɔn not dɛn
guide.season.notes: Not dɛn fɔ di sizɔn wit dɛn det. Yu ebul ad, chenj ɛn dilit dɛn, ɛn bring bak ol vɛshɔn fɔ wan not.
guide.season.files.label: Fil foto ɛn grɔn tɛst ripɔt
guide.season.files: Aplod foto fɔ di fil ɛn di grɔn tɛst PDF frɔm di lab.
guide.season.log.label: Fil rikɔd
guide.season.log: Wetin yu si na di fil, ɛn wetin yu du to am, lɛk spre wit di prɔdɔkt ɛn aw bɔku yu yus.
guide.season.history.label: Chenj istori
guide.season.history: Ɛni chenj we dɛn sev fɔ dis sizɔn, wit in det.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Eria avɛrij mak
guide.season.benchmark: Di avɛrij yild fɔ di eria frɔm pɔblik nɔmba dɛn. Na fɔ kɔmpia nɔmɔ; nɔto di yild fɔ yu fil.
guide.season.pests.label: Pest dɛn na di eria
guide.season.pests: Pest dɛn we dɛn ripɔt nia di fil pan GBIF, wan pɔblik data ples fɔ tin dɛn we pipul si. Prez Fetch sightings fɔ gɛt di nyu wan dɛn.
guide.sources.title: Usay di nɔmba dɛn kɔmɔt
guide.sources.weather: Weda de kɔmɔt na Open-Meteo, fɔ tide, di fɔkast ɛn di dez we dɔn pas.
guide.sources.soil: Grɔn data de kɔmɔt na SoilGrids, wan wɔl map fɔ grɔn.
guide.sources.pests: Pest dɛn we dɛn si de kɔmɔt na GBIF, wan pɔblik data ples fɔ tin dɛn we pipul si.
guide.sources.yields: Eria yild dɛn de kɔmɔt na USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ɛn di World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Ɔl di ɔda tin dɛn, lɛk not dɛn, wok we dɛn du ɛn yu yon yild dɛn, na wetin yu ɔ yu tim tayp insay.
guide.limits.title: Wetin i nɔ ebul du
guide.limits.model: Di it yunit dɛn we ɛni krɔp nid na wi yon ɛstimɛt, ɛn dɛn nɛva tɛst dɛn na fil. Yus dɛn as gayd, ɛn biliv wetin yu si na yu fil.
guide.limits.maturity: Wɛda don sho se di krop fɔ dɔn rɛdi. Na yu nɔmɔ sabi if i rili rɛdi.
guide.limits.translation: AI na in rayt di transleshɔn dɛn. Dɛn fɔ izi fɔ ɔndastand, bɔt pɔsin we sabi di langwej gud nɔ chɛk ɔl.
guide.limits.demo: Ɛnibɔdi kin yuz di demo, so nɔ rayt ɛnitin we praivet de.
